findings.interpretation: A concrete missing teaching case inside the actual default generated domain. It does not contradict the narrowly stated nine-rival theorem, but it leaves a simple canonical-fitting program consistent with every visible example and wrong on the public query. Root has requested a repair: declare this tenth rival and guarantee a positive nonrectangular overlap patch in the demonstrations.
findings.proposed_repair: Use a corner-cut monochrome 4x4 patch in the unforced overlap profile; its three matching windows refute the complete-rectangles-only rival without increasing reserved slot size, object count, or palette constraints. Update grammar, observation, overlap witness, tests and teaching documentation consistently.
findings.rival_description: Partition input into four-connected nonzero components; ignore mixed-color or non-rectangular components; shrink each solid monochrome rectangle by one boundary cell on each side. This is outside the declared nine-rival set.
